body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2008 CES') -- <Visual News> Panasonic unveiled world's largest 150-inch plasma display during CES 2008.
Panasonic announced at CES 2008, that its entire 2008 line of HD flat screen TV will be branded VIERA®.

The re-branding of its HD flat screen TVs for 2008 signals Panasonic's total commitment to the flat panel market, both in Plasma and LCD televisions. All 21 of the VIERA televisions provide the consumer with superb picture quality, convenient networking capabilities and superior customer service via its award winning Concierge program.
